summary: Validation state of a placement, written by esv::placement::ValidationSystem (GatherValidationRequests / ProcessValidationRequests, Toolkit EoCServer.dll+0x2F4790 / +0x2F5690), which checks every actor of the PlacementComponent map (alive, not incapacitated, not in repose, item not moved) and records an esv::placement::EFailureType per entity. Seen.py context: dialogues with several NPCs and scripted events.

fields.name: State
fields.evidence: Creator bg3.exe+0x2F0C7F0 (3 bytes) writes 0 (pending). The per-frame update of esv::placement::ValidationSystem bg3.exe+0x2F0AF60 writes 1 for every entity of its 'valid' list and 2 for every entity of its 'failed' list (via getter bg3.exe+0x2F0C960). Live 0, 1, 2.

fields.name: Failure
fields.evidence: Payload of an optional failure code: bg3.exe+0x2F0AF60 stores the per-entity byte of the failed list (enum esv::placement::EFailureType, 1 byte) here together with State = 2. Left unwritten by the creator (stale while HasFailure is 0). Live 0, 2, 4, 0x0A.

fields.name: HasFailure
fields.evidence: Engaged flag of that optional: the creator zeroes byte 2; bg3.exe+0x2F0AF60 sets it to 1 (if it was 0) when it stores Failure. Live 0/1.

second_pass: The Windows creator bg3.exe+0x2F0C7F0 and ValidationSystem's update bg3.exe+0x2F0AF60 show byte 0 is the state (0 pending, 1 valid, 2 failed) and bytes 1-2 are an optional EFailureType (value, engaged flag).
